title: A lidar map of the world: the ground beneath the trees
excerpt: Fifteen national laser surveys in one zoomable map. Hillforts hidden in forests, the craters of Verdun, the mine craters of Messines, Roman gold mines and the biggest burial mound in Japan: what the land looks like with every tree and building taken away.
seo_description: A lidar map of the world: national lidar from England, France, Flanders, the Netherlands, Switzerland, Japan, the US and more in one zoomable map, with 23 places lidar reveals.
header_alt: Lidar shaded relief in grey: the rings of ramparts and ditches of Maiden Castle, an Iron Age hillfort in Dorset, lit from the top left, beside the title A lidar map of the world.
